abstract: Deploy TensorRT-LLM with NVIDIA Dynamo on Kubernetes as disaggregated prefill and decode workers. Covers the dynamo-platform chart, Grove with KAI Scheduler or LeaderWorkerSet with Volcano, DynamoGraphDeployment v1beta1 templates, engine YAMLs with cache_transceiver_config, NIXL over RDMA or EFA, the KV-aware router, Planner scaling, the TRT-LLM release-candidate pin, failure modes and verification gaps. References are split into platform install, deployment, KV transfer and networking, and routing, scaling and operations.
